verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a RESTful public API (gitbook-docs-36), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for that API. The probe of common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all of them. The OpenAPI material (gitbook-docs-23, gitbook-docs-35) covers customers importing their own specs into their docs, not GitBook publishing its own spec, so it does not count here.
